colours.name: Red
alts: Double Wave Slide red double-lane wave slide with wide steel ladder

data.description: The 5 ft Double Wave Slide has two red lanes running side by side, each with a wave profile, and a wide steel ladder so two children can climb together. Racing a friend down the twin lanes is half the fun. The added height over our 3 ft model gives the waves more lift, so the ride suits children who have outgrown toddler slides. Two lanes also help on a busy school ground or society garden, since twice as many children get a turn. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are covered by our standard 3-year warranty. Tell us how many children use your play area and we will advise on slide size.

items.pText: The 5 ft Double Wave Slide has two red lanes running side by side, each with a wave profile, and a wide steel ladder so two children can climb together. Racing a friend down the twin lanes is half the fun. The added height over our 3 ft model gives the waves more lift, so the ride suits children who have outgrown toddler slides. Two lanes also help on a busy school ground or society garden, since twice as many children get a turn. Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts are covered by our standard 3-year warranty. Tell us how many children use your play area and we will advise on slide size.

A wide galvanised ladder serves both lanes. We fix it self-standing or grout it, as the ground requires. Two children exit together, so plan a broad landing zone with rubber flooring and keep it clear of benches. Check both lanes, the ladder and all fixings at each maintenance visit.
